mapper.sql: r.id, r.serial_no, r.employee_id, r.work_type_id, r.service_date, r.start_time, r.end_time, r.location, r.latitude, r.longitude, r.geo_captured, r.content, r.remark, r.status, r.is_backfill, r.reject_reason, r.submitted_at, r.confirmed_at, r.rejected_at, r.snap_billing_mode, r.snap_unit_price, r.snap_overtime_start, r.snap_overtime_multiplier, r.snap_rounding_rule, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.del_flag, e.name AS employee_name, w.name AS work_type_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM smt_work_record r LEFT JOIN smt_employee e ON e.id = r.employee_id AND e.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN smt_work_type w ON w.id = r.work_type_id AND w.del_flag = '0' WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.del_flag = '0'
SELECT id, record_id, url, `sort`, `size`, create_time FROM smt_record_photo WHERE record_id = #{recordId} ORDER BY `sort` ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM smt_work_record WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = #{status}
SELECT MAX(serial_no) FROM smt_work_record WHERE serial_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO smt_work_record ( serial_no, employee_id, work_type_id, service_date, start_time, end_time, location, latitude, longitude, geo_captured, content, remark, status, is_backfill, reject_reason, submitted_at, confirmed_at, rejected_at, snap_billing_mode, snap_unit_price, snap_overtime_start, snap_overtime_multiplier, snap_rounding_rule, create_by, create_time, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{serialNo}, #{employeeId}, #{workTypeId}, #{serviceDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{location}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{geoCaptured}, #{content}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{isBackfill}, #{rejectReason}, IFNULL(#{submittedAt}, NOW()), #{confirmedAt}, #{rejectedAt}, #{snapBillingMode}, #{snapUnitPrice}, #{snapOvertimeStart}, #{snapOvertimeMultiplier}, #{snapRoundingRule}, #{createBy}, NOW(), '0' )

serial_no = #{serialNo},
employee_id = #{employeeId},
work_type_id = #{workTypeId},
service_date = #{serviceDate},
start_time = #{startTime},
end_time = #{endTime},
location = #{location},
latitude = #{latitude},
longitude = #{longitude},
geo_captured = #{geoCaptured},
content = #{content},
remark = #{remark},
status = #{status},
is_backfill = #{isBackfill},
reject_reason = #{rejectReason},
submitted_at = #{submittedAt},
confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt},
rejected_at = #{rejectedAt},
snap_billing_mode = #{snapBillingMode},
snap_unit_price = #{snapUnitPrice},
snap_overtime_start = #{snapOvertimeStart},
snap_overtime_multiplier = #{snapOvertimeMultiplier},
snap_rounding_rule = #{snapRoundingRule},

update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'
